visualReview.scope: Static exterior geometry at all eight source captures, plus actual GLB placement and shared-surface rendering in the map integration fixture.
visualReview.notes: Inspected all four sides, tower base/door, nacelle, rotor roots and far silhouette. The standalone source views use portable PBR fallback materials; shared painted metal and concrete were inspected in the additional runtime map views.

geographicReview.notes: Reusable category model with +Z front and Y=0 base. The synthetic semantic tile confirms mapped position, supplied heading and terrain contact. Real-site identity, height and orientation still depend on map evidence; this model has no unique geographic anchor.

fidelityReview.notes: The blade exterior uses an approximate symmetric airfoil section and reference planform, not the full aerodynamic airfoil data. The rotor is static, with no drivetrain internals or structural/collision certification. Declared size is the swept envelope, larger than the static three-blade AABB. Close blade roots retain approximate profile transitions. This review does not certify maximum fidelity.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Reviewed painted-metal tower, door, nacelle and blades plus concrete footing at close range. Metric-repeat UVs resolve canonical graphs with vertex-color tint; no per-model image copies. The fixture proves one graph read per surface and the same painted-metal texture object across both GLBs. A fixture sun bias adjustment reduced self-shadow banding before the final captures; minor shadow-map aliasing remains at small fittings.
